children: Starting Sept. 17, 2026, Catalyst Acquisition Corp. will allow separate trading of its Class A shares (CATL) and rights (CATLR); remaining units continue as CATLU. Only whole rights will trade.
Creates price discovery and liquidity for each component, often moving SPAC-related securities.
Enables targeted trading in shares vs. rights; can trigger volatility around open.
Holders with fractional rights may face execution limits; impacts retail flows.
Arb opportunities between units and components can emerge on split.

This is an early-stage procedural milestone typical for newly listed SPACs after IPO. A definitive business combination announcement or redemption vote would be the next catalyst to drive material repricing.
